5.2 LLM Agent Implementations
All agents are instantiated from the same base model GPT-4.1-mini, with their
input and output histories maintained separately. Each LLM agent receives a
structured string consisting of the prompts described in the technical appendix
and the input components listed in Figure 2. A translator based only on these
inputs can provide only context-independent translations and cannot handle
follow-up questions. To enable context-dependent translators, we leverage the
LLMcontextmemory,allowingthemtobuildonandreferencepreviousinterac-
tions, and thus provide the benefits listed in Section 3. Although LLM contexts
can, in principle, retain all prior user interactions, we maintain separate con-
